title: 创建半透明图标
prompt: Create a 3D-rendered icon of [Subject] in a dreamy, translucent, glass-like plastic material with soft pink and purple hues. glossy, smooth, rounded edges, glowing highlights, and soft shimmer or sparkle effects. UI, floating against a clean white background with soft shadows and natural lighting, elegant, and modern.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创建梦幻半透明的 3D 图标，融合柔和粉紫色调与玻璃质感，为自然主题的 UI 设计增添优雅现代的光泽效果。
